emergence.summary: A single-gene ABCD1 loss-of-function. ABCD1 encodes the adrenoleukodystrophy protein (ALDP), the peroxisomal-membrane ABC half-transporter that IMPORTS very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoAs (VLCFA-CoA) into the peroxisome for beta-oxidation. ALDP is the BRAKE on VLCFA accumulation; with ABCD1 LOF the import fails, VLCFA cannot reach the peroxisomal degradation machinery, and saturated VLCFA (C24:0, C26:0) ACCUMULATE in plasma and tissues -> adrenal cortical insufficiency (Addison disease), and, in the dreaded childhood cerebral form, an inflammatory demyelination of cerebral white matter; adult males develop the slowly progressive myelopathy adrenomyeloneuropathy. The VLCFA-load axis is driven UP. Read as a released BRAKE on toxic accumulation (ALDP imports VLCFA for degradation; LOF releases the clearance -> VLCFA UP) -- the released-brake -> over-accumulation convention (tyrosinaemia / haemochromatosis / cystinosis / NPC1) carried onto a NEW ORGANELLE: the PEROXISOME. Every prior storage read in the kit is LYSOSOMAL; X-ALD is the FIRST peroxisomal read, and the contrast is sharp -- the lysosomal transport-defect reads (cystinosis CTNS, Niemann-Pick C NPC1) are EXPORT defects (cargo trapped INSIDE the lysosome), whereas ABCD1 is an IMPORT defect (cargo cannot ENTER the peroxisome to be degraded), opposite transport directions on different organelles, both releasing a brake on accumulation. Because no approved small molecule lowers the CNS VLCFA burden in a disease-modifying way, the lead is the definitive switch-level restoration: add a functional ABCD1 gene (autologous CD34+ haematopoietic-stem-cell ex-vivo lentiviral ABCD1 gene addition, elivaldogene autotemcel / Skysona, approved for early cerebral ALD), whose donor-derived microglia restore peroxisomal VLCFA beta-oxidation in the CNS and arrest demyelination -- the net axis effect LOWERS the VLCFA burden, so it is restrain-coded (the OTC / cystinosis-gene-restore convention). Allogeneic haematopoietic-stem-cell transplantation is the established equivalent (donor-derived microglia supply functional ALDP), also restrain-coded by net axis effect. Lorenzo's oil (glyceryl trioleate + trierucate) NORMALISES PLASMA VLCFA but does NOT prevent or modify cerebral disease and is recorded as a downstream / biomarker-only NON-lever (the LAL-D statin discipline -- it moves a marker without touching the switch outcome). The gamma read is of the ABCD1 locus switch STRUCTURE -- a CpG-island promoter (GC ~0.68), one of the deepest switches in the kit (third behind FGFR3 and HTT); the disease lesion is coding (the recurrent p.Arg104Cys / p.Arg152Cys / p.Pro560Leu missense alleles), outside the promoter firewall. Phenotype is famously UNPREDICTABLE from genotype (the same ABCD1 allele can give cerebral ALD, adrenomyeloneuropathy or Addison-only, even within a family), so penetrance / clinical-course magnitude is held [O]. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: peroxisomal very-long-chain-fatty-acid (VLCFA) load (saturated C24:0/C26:0 accumulation from failed peroxisomal beta-oxidation import) -- the kit's first PEROXISOMAL read, the import-defect contrast to the lysosomal export-defect storage reads

ncbi.description: ATP binding cassette subfamily D member 1

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: ABCD1 encodes ALDP, the peroxisomal ABC half-transporter that imports VLCFA-CoA into the peroxisome for beta-oxidation -- the BRAKE on VLCFA accumulation. LOF blocks import -> VLCFA cannot be degraded -> they accumulate (axis UP). Xq28 (OMIM 300371). NCBI official symbol ABCD1. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the coding missense/null lesions are outside the promoter firewall.
per_gene.src: Mosser 1993 Nature 361:726 (ABCD1 identified as the X-ALD gene); Kemp 2012 Nat Rev Endocrinol 8:740 (ALDP and VLCFA beta-oxidation)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: add a functional ABCD1 gene so donor-derived CNS microglia restore peroxisomal VLCFA beta-oxidation -> the VLCFA burden falls and demyelination is arrested; net axis effect LOWERS the load (definitive, switch-level)
levers.agent_class: ex-vivo lentiviral ABCD1 gene addition to autologous CD34+ HSCs (elivaldogene autotemcel / Skysona)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree / durability of restored peroxisomal VLCFA oxidation / demyelination arrest not derived from sequence
levers.src: Eichler 2017 NEJM 377:1630 (Lenti-D / elivaldogene autotemcel in cerebral ALD); elivaldogene autotemcel (Skysona) FDA 2022

levers.push_direction: supply functional ALDP via donor-derived microglia (allogeneic HSCT) -> restore peroxisomal VLCFA beta-oxidation in the CNS -> lower the VLCFA burden (the established equivalent of gene addition); net axis effect LOWERS the load
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of CNS engraftment / VLCFA lowering not derived from sequence
levers.src: Shapiro 2000 Lancet 356:713 (HSCT halts cerebral ALD); Mahmood 2007 Lancet Neurol 6:687 (long-term HSCT outcomes)

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: ABCD1 LOF (released import brake) raises the VLCFA load (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: an ABCD1 LOF allele that LOWERED plasma C26:0 / VLCFA, or cells in which ALDP loss REDUCED VLCFA accumulation, would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma / fibroblast saturated VLCFA (C26:0 and the C26:0/C22:0 ratio) by ABCD1 genotype

falsifiers.claim: restoring ABCD1 (gene addition / HSCT) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the VLCFA load / arrests demyelination)
falsifiers.falsifier: if adding functional ABCD1 or engrafting donor microglia RAISED VLCFA or accelerated demyelination, the restore-ABCD1 (restrain-by-net-effect) lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: CNS VLCFA / MRI demyelination (Loes score) progression after ABCD1 gene addition or HSCT

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
